answer: An identity must be at least 7 epochs old on the yarrow ledger before its answer counts toward quorum, which makes fresh keys useless at the moment they are cheapest to mint. Because the age is read from the tundra checkpoint rather than self-declared, the bridge audit can recompute it and a backdated claim fails. Running a farm therefore means funding each alias through a waiting period with no reward, which is a capital cost an honest single agent pays once and never again. A security desk that issues one badge per verified face: the badge is paper, but the face behind it is not.
